theorems.name: Submission.p08_7d1ff633a4_tp26_coset_averaging
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G X : Type} [Field k] [Group G] [MulAction G X] (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype (G ⧸ H)] (V : Rep.{0} k G) (t : (G ⧸ H) → G), (∀ c : G ⧸ H, (t c : G ⧸ H) = c) → ∃ T : (X → V) →ₗ[k] (X → V), (∀ (F : X → V) (x : X), T F x = ∑ c : G ⧸ H, V.ρ (t c) (F ((t c)⁻¹ • x))) ∧ (∀ F : X → V, (∀ (h : H) (x : X), F ((h : G) • x) = V.ρ (h : G) (F x)) → ∀ (s : G) (x : X), T F (s • x) = V.ρ s (T F x)) ∧ (∀ F : X → V, (∀ (s : G) (x : X), F (s • x) = V.ρ s (F x)) → ∀ x : X, T F x = (H.index : k) • F x) ∧ (∀ u : (G ⧸ H) → G, (∀ c : G ⧸ H, (u c : G ⧸ H) = c) → ∀ F : X → V, (∀ (h : H) (x : X), F ((h : G) • x) = V.ρ (h : G) (F x)) → ∀ x : X, T F x = ∑ c : G ⧸ H, V.ρ (u c) (F ((u c)⁻¹ • x)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
